name: extract_discovery_details
description: Capture the bridging details: `{{industry}}`, `{{pain_points}}` (APPEND — keep every existing item), `{{interest_signal}}`, `{{pattern_matched}}`, `{{call_volume}}`, `{{pain_urgency}}`. Call it once when the four required values exist.

variables.name: industry
variables.description: Business industry or vertical (e.g. "HVAC", "dental practice", "law firm")

variables.name: pain_points
variables.description: Comma-separated list of ALL problems mentioned. APPEND only — keep every existing item and add new ones. Never replace.

variables.name: interest_signal
variables.description: True when the prospect asked how it works / how much / told me more, or showed clear buying intent.

variables.name: pattern_matched
variables.description: True once the prospect connected their pain_frame to what happens when calls go unanswered.

variables.name: call_volume
variables.description: Approximate call volume (can be qualitative: "10-15 calls a day", "a lot", "dozens")

variables.name: pain_urgency
variables.description: Urgency from their signals: high if losing customers or money, medium if staff stressed, low if just exploring.

name: discovery_completed
description: Set discovery_completed to true ONLY after: When the industry is known, problems are collected, they've connected their pain to the phone gap, and they've shown intent. Do not set it early.

variables.name: discovery_completed
variables.description: true ONLY after: When the industry is known, problems are collected, they've connected their pain to the phone gap, and they've shown intent.
